observations: Silver Yamaha keyboard with a blue LCD screen.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is printed on the left side panel.
The model 'MMS' is printed on the top right of the control panel.
The keyboard has 61 keys (white and black).
The unit is shown in a domestic or workshop setting with other electronic equipment in the background.
A watermark 'BLESSED TUNESONIC VENTURES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha MMS, not an Mm6.
The photo shows the physical layout but does not demonstrate the pitch bend function working.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or the LCD screen may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powering on and the screen displaying a menu.

risks.risk: Individual keys or the sustain pedal may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or have distorted sound.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the keyboard playing a test tone.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and the LCD screen working.
Video of a chromatic scale being played to test all keys.
Video of the keyboard playing a test tone to check the speakers.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha MMS keyboard from photo 0. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
